parameters.name: All
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to remove all tags from clusters. Default value: false. Valid values:

*   **true**
*   **false**

>  If you specify TagKey and this parameter, this parameter does not take effect.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID.

>  You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~143074~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The ID of cluster N. Valid values of N: 1 to 50.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The resource type. Set the value to **ALIYUN::ADB::CLUSTER**.

parameters.name: TagKey
parameters.description: The key of tag N. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun adb untag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type ALIYUN::ADB::CLUSTER --all false --resource-id am-t4n6k19t9p9f3d0j0 --tag-key productvalue --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun adb UntagResources --region cn-hangzhou --All false --ResourceId.1 'am-t4n6k19t9p9f3d0j0' --TagKey.1 productvalue --ResourceType 'ALIYUN::ADB::CLUSTER' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
